title: Join the community
lead: CyberHeaven is free and run by the people who use it. Here’s where to find us, and how to help keep it going.
seo: Join the CyberHeaven community on Discord and social media, and find out how to write, review or volunteer.

channels.name: Discord
channels.text: Where the community lives. Ask questions, share what you’re learning, find study partners and help plan what we write next.

channels.name: X (Twitter)
channels.text: New guides and resources as they land.

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.text: Follow along and connect with other learners and practitioners.

channels.name: Email
channels.text: For anything else, or if you’d rather not use social media.

waysHeading: {count} ways to help keep it going

ways.title: Write an article
ways.text: Know something a beginner would find useful? Pitch a topic and we’ll help you shape it. Published free, with your name and your own profile on the team page.

ways.title: Suggest a resource
ways.text: Found a free course, lab or tool that helped you? Tell us and it can go on the resources page.

ways.title: Review and edit
ways.text: Fix a typo, check a technical detail or bring an old guide up to date. Every correction helps the next learner.

ways.title: Help on Discord
ways.text: Answer questions, welcome new members and share what you’ve learned. You don’t need to be an expert to be helpful.

ways.title: Improve the site
ways.text: Designers and developers welcome. The site is built with Astro and plain Markdown, so small fixes are easy to make.
